map.pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]，本工具由 pH 求氢离子浓度，反之亦然。: pH = -log10[H+]; this tool derives the hydrogen ion concentration from pH and vice versa.
map.对数理解：每降 1 个 pH，[H⁺] 升 10 倍。: A logarithmic way to read it: every drop of 1 pH means [H+] rises tenfold.
map.报告换算：实验 pH 转浓度列检验报告。: Report conversion: turn experimental pH into concentration columns for a test report.
map.：输入 pH=2.5，工具输出 [H⁺]≈3.16×10⁻³ mol/L，并提示: Entering pH=2.5, the tool outputs [H+] = 3.16e-3 mol/L and notes that pH + pOH = 14 (at 25C).
map.判断反应进行的方向: Determine the direction the reaction proceeds
map.由离子浓度求溶度积或反之: Solubility product from ion concentrations or vice versa
map.pH 负数是啥？: What does a negative pH mean?
map.强酸高浓度 [H⁺]>1 时 pH<0，数学上可能，但常规表 0–14。: When a strong acid is concentrated enough that [H+] > 1 the pH is below 0, which is mathematically possible, but ordinary tables stop at 0-14.
map.和 pOH 关系？: What is the relation to pOH?
map.pH+pOH=14（25°C），可联算。: pH + pOH = 14 (at 25C), so you can compute them together.
